topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text:
Well, now, this soil, it holds many secrets, just like the mind of a man can. I was tending my plot, hoeing away at the stubborn earth, thinking on this new contraption you've told me about. A clever thing, surely, to lift water from the well with less strain. But it seems another has already claimed the idea as his own, planted a flag upon it. 

I say, the earth gives to all who toil, not just the first to stake a claim. Your thoughts, they are as fertile as the richest loam. Keep turning them over, and perhaps a new idea will sprout, one not yet harvested by another's hand. The saints watch over us all, guiding our labors. Keep your faith, and your toil will bear fruit in due time.
